Wavelet and superlet transforms

Continuous wavelet, superlet, adaptive and cross transforms, and their plots.

analyse_wavelet() analyze_wavelet()
Conduct the continuous wavelet transform on a time series/signal
analyse_superlet() analyze_superlet()
Conduct the superlet transform on a time series or signal
analyse_Awavelet() analyze_Awavelet()
Conduct the adaptive continuous wavelet transform on a time series or signal
analyse_Xwavelet() analyze_Xwavelet()
Conduct the cross wavelet transform on a time series or signal
analyse_Xsuperlet() analyze_Xsuperlet()
Conduct the cross superlet transform on a time series or signal
analyse_wavelet_coherence() analyze_wavelet_coherence()
Cross-wavelet coherence analysis
plot_wavelet()
Plots a wavelet scalogram
plot_superlet()
Plots a superlet scalogram
plot_Awavelet()
Plots a adaptive wavelet scalogram
plot_Xwavelet()
Plots a cross wavelet scalogram
plot_Xsuperlet()
Plots a cross superlet scalogram
plot_wavelet_coherence()
Plots a cross wavelet scalogram
plot_avg_wavelet()
Plot the average spectral power of a wavelet spectra
add_wavelet()
Add a wavelet plot
add_wavelet_avg()
Add a plot of a the average spectral power of a continous wavelet transform

Synchrosqueezing, chirplets and de-chirped spectra

Sharpened scalograms, chirp-matched spectra and checks of an age model in the de-chirped record.

analyse_wavelet_sst() analyze_wavelet_sst()
Wavelet synchrosqueezing transform
analyse_superlet_sst() analyze_superlet_sst()
Superlet synchrosqueezing: consensus of synchrosqueezed transforms with short and long wavelets
analyse_chirplet_sst() analyze_chirplet_sst()
Synchrosqueezed wavelet-chirplet transform
analyse_conceft() analyze_conceft()
Multitaper synchrosqueezing (ConceFT) of a record
analyse_chirp_wavelet() analyze_chirp_wavelet()
Chirp-matched wavelet scalogram with the astronomical template over rate and rate gradient
analyse_chirp_eha() analyze_chirp_eha()
Chirp-matched evolutive harmonic analysis (de-chirped windowed multitaper spectra)
chirp_eha_significance()
Significance of the lines of a (de-chirped) EHA map against warped noise
plot_chirp_eha()
Plot a chirp-matched EHA map, with or without the surrogate significance
rate_gram()
Rate-gram: the astronomical template as a spectrum over sedimentation rate, per window
analyse_dechirped()
De-chirped scalogram of any transform: the record warped to time with a track, transformed, mapped back to depth
plot_dechirped()
Plot a de-chirped scalogram
check_agemodel()
Check an age model against the de-chirped record: where do the astronomical cycles bend away?
plot_agemodel_check()
Plot an age-model check: the de-chirped maps, the rate corrections the cycles ask for and the flagged intervals
detect_transients()
Transient (impulsive) features of a record by transient extraction

Significance and uncertainty of spectra

wavelet_significance()
Significance of wavelet and superlet power: analytic and surrogate (Monte Carlo) levels
wavelet_band_significance() plot(<wr_band_significance>)
Significance of scale-averaged wavelet power (Torrence and Compo, section 4d)
sst_significance()
Significance of synchrosqueezed (and other) scalograms against autocorrelated noise
model_red_noise_wt()
Models average spectral power based curves based on a red-noise signal generated using the characteristics of an input signal.
percentile_from_red_noise()
Calculate average spectral power from red noise curves for a given percentile
wavelet_uncertainty()
Calculate the uncertainty associated with the wavelet analysis based on the Gabor uncertainty principle
fft_uncertainty()
Calculate the uncertainty associated with a tracked cycle based on the frequency uncertainty of the FFT
fft_frequency_uncertainty()
Frequency uncertainty of the Fourier transform (FFT) for a record length
wr_coloured_noise() wr_brewer_palettes() wr_colored_noise()
Colour noise and palette helpers

Evolutive harmonic analysis, windowed FFT, MESA, multitaper, SWA, Bayesian and bispectral analysis.

eha_log2()

plot_eha_log2()
Plots an log2 spaced EHA spectra
win_fft()
Windowed fft based spectral analysis
plot_win_fft()
Plot windowed fft based spectral analysis results
mesa_spectrum()
Maximum entropy spectral analysis (MESA, Burg)
mesa_evolutive()
Evolutive maximum entropy spectral analysis (evolutive MESA)
mesa_average()

plot_mesa_spectrum()

plot_mesa_evolutive()
Plot an evolutive MESA
track_mesa()
Track a spectral peak through an evolutive MESA
amtm_spectrum()
Adaptive multitaper spectrum with background fit and periodic signal detection
amtm_prewhiten()
Autoregressive prewhitening of a series for aMTM analysis
plot_amtm_spectrum()
Plot an adaptive multitaper spectrum with background and detections
swa_spectrum()
Power spectrum with SWA background, chi-square and FDR confidence levels
swa_background()
Smoothed Window Average (SWA) spectral background
bayes_spectrum()
Bayesian probability spectrum
spectral_moments()
Sliding-window spectral moments (mean frequency and bandwidth)
plot_spectral_moments()
Plot the result of spectral_moments
bispectral_analysis()
Bispectral analysis: bispectrum, biphase and squared bicoherence
bispectral_surrogate()

plot_bispectral()
Plot the result of a bispectral analysis
cycle_band()
Period range implied by the frequency resolution of a record

Tracking cycles

Interactive and automatic tracking of the period of a cycle and of the sedimentation rate.

track_period()
Track the period of a cycle in a wavelet or superlet scalogram
track_period_wavelet()
Track the period of a cycle in a wavelet spectra
delpts_tracked_period_wt()
Remove tracking points which were tracked in a wavelet spectra
completed_series()
Complete the tracking of the period a cycle in a scalogram
retrack_wt_MC()
Re-track cycles using a Monte-Carlo simulation
loess_auto()
Perform an automatically loess based smoothing of a time series
track_ridge_hmm()
Continuous tracking of a cycle in a (synchrosqueezed) scalogram with a hidden Markov model
track_astro_hmm()
Astronomically constrained continuous tracking of the sedimentation rate in a scalogram
track_astro_auto()
Recommended workflow for continuous astronomical tracking of noisy records
track_astro_iterative()
Iterative (demodulated) astronomical tracking of the sedimentation rate
track_chirp_hmm()
Chirp-steered tracking of the sedimentation rate (rate and rate gradient as the hidden state)
plot_track()
Plot a continuous track on its scalogram
plot_astro_evidence()
Map of the astronomical evidence against sedimentation rate and depth
astro_periods_tracking()
Astronomical periods and weights for tracking, for any age
as_wr_track()
Build a track (depth, sedimentation rate, time) from a tracked period curve, a rate curve or an age model

Extracting signals and filtering

extract_signal()
Extract signal from a wavelet spectra using a traced period curve
extract_signal_stable()
Extract a signal/cycle from a wavelet spectra using a set period and boundaries
extract_signal_stable_V2()
Extract signal from a wavelet spectrum using a upper and lower period boundary
extract_signal_standard_deviation()
Extract a signal using standard deviation
dynamic_extraction()
Extract a signal in between tracked boundaries in a wavelet scalogram
extract_amplitude()
Extract the instantaneous amplitude (envelope) of a signal using the CWT
extract_power()
Extract power from a wavelet spectra
extract_power_stable()
Extract power from a wavelet spectra by using a constant period/duration
gaussian_bandpass()
Gaussian band-pass filter (Acycle)
dynamic_filter()
Dynamic (depth-varying) Gaussian band-pass filter
dynamic_filter_controls()
Build dynamic-filter control points from a tracked period curve
plot_dynamic_filter()
Plot the result of a dynamic filter
max_detect()
Detect and filter out all maxima in a signal
min_detect()
Detect and filter out all minima in a signal

Sedimentation rates and astronomical testing

TimeOpt with noise correction, COCO and eCOCO, and other estimates of the sedimentation rate.

astro_sedrate_test()
Test sedimentation rates with noise-corrected TimeOpt, likelihood and COCO scores
plot(<astro_sedrate_test>)
Plot an astro_sedrate_test result
astro_sedrate_multi()
Combined astronomical test for several proxies and sections
plot(<astro_sedrate_multi>)
Plot an astro_sedrate_multi result
astro_tune_test()
Test a minimal tuning: multi-band rate tracking with surrogates run through the whole chain
plot(<astro_tune_test>)
Plot an astro_tune_test result
win_timeOpt()
Windowed timeOpt sedimentation rate estimation
plot_win_timeOpt()
plot the windowed timeOpt sedimentation rate estimation
win_timeOpt_multi()
Windowed timeOpt with precession, short-eccentricity and obliquity interpretations
plot_win_timeOpt_multi()
Plot the fits of win_timeOpt_multi side by side
flmw()
Fit linear models to spectral peaks extracted from the wavelet spectra to astronomical cycles multiplied by sedimentation rate x
flmw_path()
Smooth sedimentation rate curve with uncertainty from a flmw score matrix
plot_sed_model()
Plot sedimentation modelling results
sum_power_sedrate()
Calculate sum of maximum spectral power for sedimentation rates for a wavelet spectra
coco_classic()
COCO analysis (Li et al. 2018)
plot(<coco_classic>)
Plot a COCO result (Li et al. 2018 method)
coco_adaptive()

coco_adaptive_evaluate()
Evaluate Adaptive COCO for a batch of spectra (cocoAdaptiveEvaluate.m)
coco_prepare_regular_data()
Prepare a depth series for COCO (cocoPrepareRegularData.m)
coco_target_fixed()
Fixed-weight astronomical target spectrum (Fixed-target COCO)
coco_fixed_target_weights()
Fixed sinusoid-amplitude weights for a COCO target (cocoFixedTargetWeights.m)
coco_target_from_periods()
Target periodogram from a list of orbital periods (period2spectrum.m)
coco_target_from_series()

ecoco_adaptive()

ecoco_interleaved()

Best sedimentation rate per eCOCO window
ecoco_track()
Track sedimentation-rate solutions through eCOCO peak maps

curve2time()
Convert the tracked curve to a depth time space
curve2time_unc()
Convert the re-tracked curve results to a depth time space with uncertainty
curve2time_unc_anchor()
Convert the re-tracked curve results to a depth time space with uncertainty

Convert data from the depth to the time domain
curve2sedrate()

sedrate2tune()
Use a sedimentation curve to convert data to the time domain

astro_anchor()

Bayesian age-depth models

Radioisotopic dates combined with a floating astrochronology (astroMCBchron), and a pure-R modifiedBChron.

astroMCBchron()
Joint Bayesian age-depth model of radioisotopic dates and a floating astrochronology (astroMCBchron)
plot(<astroMCBchron>)
Plot an astroMCBchron model
predict(<astroMCBchron>)
Predict ages at new positions from an astroMCBchron model
modBchron()
Run a modified version of the Bchronology algorithm from the R package "Bchron" (Haslett and Parnell, 2008)
modBchron_predict()
Predict ages at new positions from a modBchron (or modifiedBChron) model
upb_grain_loglik()
Eruption-age likelihoods from single-zircon U-Pb dates (for astroMCBchron)

pda_legacy()

rho1_evolutive()

lag_1()
lag-1 autocorrelation coefficient
bayes_changepoint()

bayes_changepoint_r2()
R-squared of the Bayesian change point model as a function of the maximum number of change points
plot_bayes_changepoint()
Plot the result of bayes_changepoint

Precession constant, astronomical periods and the Earth-Moon system

Astronomical periods for any age, tests of the precession constant and Earth-Moon parameters.

ctest()
CTest: astronomical parameters from interpreted spectral peaks
plot(<ctest>)
Plot the CTest posterior distributions
print(<ctest>)
Print a CTest result
ctest_input()
Build the CTest input table from interpreted cycle wavelengths
ctest_combine()
Combine several CTest results by multiplying their densities
ctest_earthmoon()
Earth-Moon distance, length of day and obliquity for CTest samples
astro_ctest()
Consistency-test inversion (the estimator used in the paper)
astro_from_peaks()
Astronomical parameters from spectral peaks
print(<astro_from_peaks>)
Print an astro_from_peaks result
astro_from_periods()
Astronomical parameters from a tuned record (cycles already in kyr)
astro_invert()
Joint inversion of several measured terms, with Monte Carlo uncertainty
astro_mc()
Monte Carlo consistency test for tuned (time-domain) or depth-domain cycles
plot_astro()
Six-panel summary of an inversion
astro_terms()
The menu of named astronomical terms at a given age
astro_term_search()
Which term could a measured period be?
astro_obliquity()
Obliquity at a given age, from AstroGeo22 if available, else today's value
astrogeo22()
Earth-Moon state from the AstroGeo22 model at a given age
orbit9()
Nine principal astronomical terms for a given precession constant
orbit9_at_age()
Nine orbital periods (kyr) at age_ma
orbital_periods()
All principal astronomical periods for a given precession constant
calculate_orbit9()
Nine astronomical periods at a given age
la2004_extrap()
La2004 polynomial extrapolation (Laskar et al. 2004, eqs. 39-40) Strictly valid only over a few hundred Myr; shown for comparison.
k_from_bundling()
Precession constant from bundling: precession cycles per eccentricity bundle
k_from_cycles()
Precession constant from one or more single-valued cycles
k_from_period()
Precession constant implied by one measured cycle period
k_from_ratio()
Precession constant from the RATIO of two cycles in one section
k_hypotheses()
Which precession term is that peak? One k per hypothesis.
k_scan()
Scan k and count how many measured windows a single k can satisfy
cycles_to_k()
Precession constant implied by an observed obliquity or precession cycle
bundling_ratios()
Precession cycles per eccentricity bundle, predicted
compare_published()
Compare a measured precession constant with published models
term_sensitivity()
Sensitivity of every cycle to each fundamental frequency
chaos_scenario()
Shift the fundamental frequencies and see what every cycle does
resonance_state()
Which secular resonance state does a record show?
test_tuned()
Precession-constant test for a tuned record
test_tuned_check()
Check the precession-constant test on a synthetic record
plot_test_k()
Comparison figure of the precession-constant test
earthmoon_state()
Full Earth-Moon state from any one observable
earthmoon_from_precession()
Invert the AstroGeo22 precession curve: Earth-Moon state for a measured precession frequency / period.
em_state()
Full Earth-Moon state from a precession constant
earth_moment_of_inertia()
Earth's polar moment of inertia at spin rate omega (Farhat et al. 2022, A.3)
earth_omega()
Earth's angular velocity from the length of day
earthmoon_angular_momentum()
Earth-Moon system angular momentum (spin + lunar orbit), kg m^2 s^-1
precession_frequency()
Luni-solar precession frequency (Farhat et al. 2022, eq. A.7)
lod_hours()
Length of day from Earth's angular velocity
lod_from_moon_distance()
Length of day implied by an Earth-Moon distance (angular momentum conserved)
moon_distance_from_lod()
Earth-Moon distance implied by a length of day (angular momentum conserved)
moon_distance_from_months()
Earth-Moon distance from the number of lunar months per year (the observable of tidal rhythmites)
months_per_year()
Lunar mean motion and months per year from the Earth-Moon distance (Kepler's third law, n^2 a^3 = G(M_E + M_M), as in Farhat et al. 2022 Table D.2)
omega_from_moon_distance()
Earth's spin rate implied by an Earth-Moon distance, assuming the Earth-Moon angular momentum is conserved (solar tidal drain neglected).
days_per_year()
Days in a year for a given solar day length
zeeden2023_table1()
Devonian reference values of Zeeden et al. (2023), EPSL 621, 118348, Table 1
example_pridoli()
The Pridoli example: the four terms resolved at Cellon (Carnic Alps) on the astrochronozone time scale of Arts and Da Silva.
